name: The Lindworm's Bride
source:
A young woman is sent to the castle to be the monstrous lindworm's bride... How will she fare?

[From [url=https://krispycat.itch.io/lindworm-bride]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一個年輕女子被送往城堡，要嫁給一條可怕的林德龍……她會落得怎樣的境遇？
